annotations.title: Pause a task and save a checkpoint

description: Use when you must stop mid-flight with work half-done. Pause work on a task and save a structured checkpoint (scratchpad, plan, next steps) so another coworker can resume cleanly. Releases the lease and returns the task to the queue.

checkpoint.description: Free-form JSON object holding your working state: e.g. { scratchpad, plan, next_steps, context }.

note.description: Short handoff note for whoever resumes.

task_id.description: Task id, or a pasted Tango task URL.

name: pause_task
